change_scope: Preserve observed browser request headers, including absent Referer; support direct media export links and browser attachment playback choices without site allowlists.

rerun_this_release.direct_link_validation: Real WebView link discovery and trusted navigation to cross-origin attachments; HTTP same-origin referrer policy; redirects; native playback; download output byte equality; case-insensitive captured headers and absence of stale Referer/Origin.
rerun_this_release.regression_scope: Full existing browser flow, download engine, shared media cache and download-settings progress suites passed. Includes HLS conversion, credential scope, Range fallback, concurrency, cancellation and file integrity.

inherited_baseline.scope: Earlier compact/theme artwork border checks and broader visual checks were not rerun; thumbnail drawing code is unchanged. API26 remains compile/lint checked.

release_signature: Verified; same certificate as previous releases
signed_release_manual_launch: Not rerun; runtime regression used the debug build.
privacy: Source and release APK scanned for supplied private URLs and identifiers; public tests use synthetic loopback data. Clean release source checkout excludes local diagnostics, tools, credentials and signing keys.
scope: Controlled synthetic Android regression proves the generic behavior. No claim of universal compatibility or end-to-end validation of an external export service.
